title: Pitching Guru Brent Strom Back with Astros

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Pitching Guru Brent Strom Back with Astros
sources.description: Today, Astros manager Joe Espada told the media the team has brought back former pitching coach Brent Strom as a consultant. Strom had been the person most associated with what has colloquially been called the “Astros Lab” at the start of the Golden Era.
